questionStem: What is one thing a commune could do to create suitable jobs for rural youth? Write a proposal and a reason.

taskBody.instructions: Write a short proposal and a reason, up to 120 characters each.

challengeCandidates.label: TN1
challengeCandidates.whenShownForTeacher: When the proposal is about training
challengeCandidates.message: After the training, where would these young people work?

challengeCandidates.label: TN2
challengeCandidates.whenShownForTeacher: When the proposal is about local business
challengeCandidates.message: What would the workers in this business need to know how to do?

challengeCandidates.label: TN3
challengeCandidates.whenShownForTeacher: When the proposal is about living conditions
challengeCandidates.message: How would this help young people find a job, not only live better?

challengeCandidates.label: Fallback
challengeCandidates.whenShownForTeacher: When none of the above applies
challengeCandidates.message: Read your reason again. Which part of the source does it rest on?

feedback.text: The source links jobs for rural youth to vocational training, local businesses and better living conditions. There is no single right proposal.
